name: BRAND TEXT
description: Beauty Saunas & Baths believes in a deeply practical and highly functional approach to everything: special features, innovative technology, comfort, convenience and quality. What is more appealing is that our customer service does not end after the sale of our products – we ensure years of joy and benefits with post-sale support service with the best of our certified experts.  Therapy, rejuvenation, relaxation, serenity – all this is available with Infrared Sauna therapy. Make your own oasis of joy and health anywhere in your home and enjoy all the benefits Infrared has to offer.  Once Infrared saunas were a luxury, but with the modern technologies everything is possible – even creating an affordable Infrared therapy retreat at any home.  Beauty Saunas offers top quality non-toxic materials and sturdy wooden construction of each sauna unit, equipped with ceramic heaters with low EMF, stereo system, color therapy lights, comfortable insides of each sauna and a guarantee that will please any customer.  Feeling the need to be healthy and beautiful? Infrared saunas improve skin tone, circulation and boost the immune system, so infrared therapy is great as an anti-aging therapy. Still not convinced? The deep penetration of the heat very similar to that of the sun also helps with sore muscles and sport injuries, arthritis and so much more!
